只更新已检测到的 DLSS 文件，不添加游戏未实现的功能。原件会备份；游戏更新或: Updates detected DLSS files only; it cannot add missing game features. Originals are backed up. Later game updates or third-party changes are preserved.
XeSS 运行库仅用于 MFG 1.7+ 独立模式，安装后需在参数设置或 Bac: XeSS runtimes are for MFG 1.7+ standalone mode. Enable it in Parameters or the Backspace menu after installation. DLSS originals can be restored separately here.
需要 MFG 1.7+ 和 NR 运行库；右侧可单独下载安装。游戏需启用 DLS: Requires MFG 1.7+ and the NR runtime, available in the sidebar. Enable DLSS SR, DLAA or RR in the game; Backspace opens the menu.
Vulkan 仅支持自动或超分后；隔帧处理仅适用于 DX12 超分前/后。高级画: Vulkan supports Auto or After upscaling only. Half-rate requires DX12 Before/After upscaling. Advanced image controls are in the in-game menu.
需要右侧安装 XeSS 3.0.2 运行库，重启游戏生效。独立模式不需要 Opt: Install the XeSS 3.0.2 runtimes in the sidebar and restart the game. Standalone mode needs no OptiScaler. In plugin mode, select XeFG in OptiScaler.
独立 XeMFG 支持 DX12/Vulkan；Vulkan 仅使用 DLSS: Standalone XeMFG supports DX12/Vulkan; Vulkan uses DLSS SR inputs only. Turn off the game's native FSR/XeSS frame generation.
MFG 1.7：Backspace 打开菜单；插件可使用 OptiScaler: MFG 1.7: Backspace opens the menu; plugins can use OptiScaler's menu. NR and standalone XeSS MFG need optional runtimes. Vulkan DLSS dynamic MFG is unavailable; standalone XeMFG supports its own dynamic mode.
MFG 1.7 支持 NR 与独立 XeSS 多帧生成。运行库可在右侧单独安装；: MFG 1.7 supports NR and standalone XeSS MFG. Install optional runtimes in the sidebar; apply manager parameters with the game closed. Disable native FSR/XeSS FG when using standalone XeMFG.
OptiScaler 插件模式使用 OptiScaler 的 XeSS 运行库；: OptiScaler plugin mode uses OptiScaler's XeSS runtimes. This installer is for standalone XeMFG.
没有发现对应的游戏运行库；不会向不支持的游戏添加此 DLL: No matching game runtime was found; this DLL will not be added to unsupported games.
运行库安装未完成，可恢复原件后重试。: Runtime installation is incomplete. Restore the original files before retrying.
NR 需要 Encore 1.1.0+ 或 MFG 1.7.0+；MFG 使用: NR requires Encore 1.1.0+ or MFG 1.7.0+. MFG uses runtime 310.9.16.
请先在所有部署目录安装 Encore 或 MFG 1.7+。: Install Encore or MFG 1.7+ in all deployment folders first.
当前游戏目录未发现 DLSS 超分或光线重建组件。: No DLSS Super Resolution or Ray Reconstruction runtime was found.
NR 运行库已安装。请在游戏中开启 DLSS/DLAA；Encore 按 Ins: NR runtime installed. Enable DLSS/DLAA in the game, then enable NR via Insert (Encore) or Backspace (MFG).
运行库已恢复原件；管理器添加的文件已移除。: Original runtimes restored; files added by the manager were removed.
XeSS 运行库已安装。请在参数设置中启用独立 XeSS 多帧生成，再启动游戏；: XeSS runtimes installed. Enable standalone XeSS MFG in Parameters before launching, or use the Backspace menu.
DLSS 运行库已更新并保留原件备份。若游戏出现兼容问题，可在运行库窗口恢复。: DLSS runtimes updated with original backups. Use the runtime window to restore them if compatibility problems occur.
仅更新游戏共用的 DLSS 文件，可能影响不同适配方案；遇到问题可恢复原件。补丁: Updates shared game DLSS files, which can affect different patches. Restore originals if needed. Patch-private runtimes are updated with the complete patch.
没有可更新的游戏运行库；补丁专用文件不在此处更新: No updatable game runtime found. Patch-private files are not updated here.
此文件属于补丁专用运行库，请更新完整适配方案: This file belongs to a patch. Update the complete patch instead.
0.4.x 各代理使用对应文件，组件共用完整包。允许多选；上游建议只放一个入口，: Each 0.4.x proxy uses its own file and shares a complete component bundle. Multiple selections are allowed; upstream recommends one entry point.
需要 R580 或更新驱动。XeSS 使用随包后端，无需另装 Intel DLL: Requires R580 or newer. XeSS uses the bundled backend, without extra Intel DLLs. RGBA16F backbuffers are unsupported; there is no automatic DLSS fallback.
默认关闭。M/L 会覆盖全部画质档，质量、平衡和 DLAA 下可能更慢。旧版 O: Off by default. M/L overrides all quality modes and may be slower in Quality, Balanced and DLAA. Legacy On and tier selection were removed.
严格模式下，游戏缺少无 HUD 输入可能直接退出；通常使用自动。: Strict mode can terminate a game that lacks HUD-less input. Auto is recommended.
游戏仍可选择更低倍率；旧代仅 2X 的 DLSS-G 接口可能不受支持，换新 D: The game can choose a lower multiplier. Legacy 2X-only DLSS-G interfaces may be unsupported; replacing DLLs does not upgrade the game interface.
0.4.1 完整包包含 DLSS / XeSS 后端和超分组件。默认 Optim: The complete 0.4.1 bundle includes DLSS / XeSS backends and SR. Defaults: Optimized=1, Preset=A, SR off. Existing settings are preserved on upgrade.
帧生成需要 R580 或更新驱动；XeSS 最高4X，不需另装 Intel DL: Frame generation requires R580 or newer. XeSS supports up to 4X with no extra Intel DLLs. Legacy 2X-only DLSS-G interfaces are unsupported; game compatibility is still required.
M/L 模式会覆盖全部画质档。旧版 On 无等价迁移，请先明确选择；严格无 HU: M/L overrides all quality modes. Legacy On has no equivalent: select a mode before upgrading. Strict HUD-less mode can terminate games without that input; use Auto.
